'''Death Star II Starter Decks''' is the 26th Star Wars CCG product, released with [[Death Star II]] on 19 July 2000. Each 60-card deck (MSRP $10.95) includes one exclusive rare packed only here, not in Death Star II boosters: [[Admiral Ackbar]] (Light) or [[Admiral Piett]] (Dark). 12 decks per box, 6 per side. Decks mix Death Star II cards and reprints from prior sets with a 2000 copyright.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
